turns.content: Consider the isotope ³⁷₁₇Cl. Its atomic number is Z = 17, and its mass number is A = 37. What does A represent?
Use A = 37 and Z = 17 to determine the number of neutrons.
Give the proton and neutron composition of the nucleus.
Check the composition against the stated value of A.

Compute the neutron-to-proton ratio N/Z.

For the rest of the calculation, carry N = 37 even though the earlier relation gives N = 20.
Summarize the nuclear composition of ³⁷₁₇Cl.
